mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope (organization_unit_id, include_descendants) AS ( SELECT scope_target_id, include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND scope_type = 'ORGANIZATION' UNION SELECT child.organization_unit_id, TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit child JOIN visible_scope parent_scope ON child.parent_id = parent_scope.organization_unit_id WHERE parent_scope.include_descendants = TRUE ) SELECT DISTINCT organization.organization_unit_id, organization.organization_code, organization.organization_name, parent.organization_name AS parent_organization_name, organization.root_unit, organization.active, organization.version_no FROM visible_scope scope JOIN seal.organization_unit organization ON organization.organization_unit_id = scope.organization_unit_id LEFT JOIN seal.organization_unit parent ON parent.organization_unit_id = organization.parent_id ORDER BY organization.root_unit DESC, organization.organization_code
